### rustfs/rustfs (rustfs)

### [`v1.0.7`](https://redirect.github.com/rustfs/rustfs/releases/tag/1.0.7): RustFS 1.0.7

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/rustfs/rustfs/compare/1.0.6...1.0.7)

<!-- rustfs-generated-release-notes: managed; remove this marker before manual edits -->

#### What's Changed

- fix(storage): backport scanner recovery and ordered shard reads by [@​overtrue](https://redirect.github.com/overtrue) in [#​9512](https://redirect.github.com/rustfs/rustfs/pull/9512)
- fix(scanner): resume wide directory scans on release 1.0.7 by [@​cxymds](https://redirect.github.com/cxymds) in [#​9523](https://redirect.github.com/rustfs/rustfs/pull/9523)
- fix(scanner): backport usage and recovery fixes to 1.0.7 by [@​cxymds](https://redirect.github.com/cxymds) in [#​9531](https://redirect.github.com/rustfs/rustfs/pull/9531)
- fix(storage): bound delete recovery and guard legacy residue cleanup by [@​cxymds](https://redirect.github.com/cxymds) in [#​9534](https://redirect.github.com/rustfs/rustfs/pull/9534)
- fix(storage): backport replacement heal and scanner fixes to 1.0.7 by [@​cxymds](https://redirect.github.com/cxymds) in [#​9533](https://redirect.github.com/rustfs/rustfs/pull/9533)
- fix(ilm): continue tier recovery past unreadable objects in 1.0.7 by [@​cxymds](https://redirect.github.com/cxymds) in [#​9539](https://redirect.github.com/rustfs/rustfs/pull/9539)
- fix(iam): backport Console STS password rotation to 1.0.7 by [@​cxymds](https://redirect.github.com/cxymds) in [#​9536](https://redirect.github.com/rustfs/rustfs/pull/9536)
- fix(admin): report inventory coverage and cluster scanner activity on 1.0.7 by [@​cxymds](https://redirect.github.com/cxymds) in [#​9540](https://redirect.github.com/rustfs/rustfs/pull/9540)
- fix(scanner): preserve discovery progress across owner cancellation by [@​cxymds](https://redirect.github.com/cxymds) in [#​9546](https://redirect.github.com/rustfs/rustfs/pull/9546)
- feat(scanner): expose durable bucket scan progress by [@​cxymds](https://redirect.github.com/cxymds) in [#​9548](https://redirect.github.com/rustfs/rustfs/pull/9548)
- fix(scanner): restore release CI and preserve admin response contracts by [@​overtrue](https://redirect.github.com/overtrue) in [#​9555](https://redirect.github.com/rustfs/rustfs/pull/9555)
- fix(scanner): preserve durable progress on wide and changing buckets by [@​overtrue](https://redirect.github.com/overtrue) in [#​9552](https://redirect.github.com/rustfs/rustfs/pull/9552)
- fix(heal): retry busy bucket repairs after a node restart by [@​overtrue](https://redirect.github.com/overtrue) in [#​9562](https://redirect.github.com/rustfs/rustfs/pull/9562)
- fix(scanner): reuse sealed page names during directory enumeration by [@​overtrue](https://redirect.github.com/overtrue) in [#​9564](https://redirect.github.com/rustfs/rustfs/pull/9564)
- fix(scanner): fence prefix usage cache fills across invalidation by [@​overtrue](https://redirect.github.com/overtrue) in [#​9566](https://redirect.github.com/rustfs/rustfs/pull/9566)
- fix(scanner): preserve inventory and maintenance coverage by [@​overtrue](https://redirect.github.com/overtrue) in [#​9567](https://redirect.github.com/rustfs/rustfs/pull/9567)
- fix(scanner): recertify legacy usage after cold restart by [@​cxymds](https://redirect.github.com/cxymds) in [#​9573](https://redirect.github.com/rustfs/rustfs/pull/9573)
- fix(scanner): resume checkpoints and expose partial progress by [@​cxymds](https://redirect.github.com/cxymds) in [#​9583](https://redirect.github.com/rustfs/rustfs/pull/9583)
- fix(scanner): preserve checkpoint coverage across handoffs by [@​cxymds](https://redirect.github.com/cxymds) in [#​9587](https://redirect.github.com/rustfs/rustfs/pull/9587)
- fix(scanner): preserve completed usage and publish initial progress by [@​cxymds](https://redirect.github.com/cxymds) in [#​9592](https://redirect.github.com/rustfs/rustfs/pull/9592)
- fix(decommission): keep scanner progress on its owning set by [@​cxymds](https://redirect.github.com/cxymds) in [#​9603](https://redirect.github.com/rustfs/rustfs/pull/9603)
- fix(sts): validate root credentials on 1.0.7 startup by [@​houseme](https://redirect.github.com/houseme) in [#​9604](https://redirect.github.com/rustfs/rustfs/pull/9604)
- fix(sts): validate root credentials and report parent access denials (1.0.7) by [@​houseme](https://redirect.github.com/houseme) in [#​9605](https://redirect.github.com/rustfs/rustfs/pull/9605)
- fix(ecstore): make release directory walks iterative by [@​houseme](https://redirect.github.com/houseme) in [#​9608](https://redirect.github.com/rustfs/rustfs/pull/9608)
- fix(scanner): backport tier registry replan to 1.0.7 by [@​cxymds](https://redirect.github.com/cxymds) in [#​9616](https://redirect.github.com/rustfs/rustfs/pull/9616)
- fix(sts): backport inline session policy Id support to 1.0.7 by [@​GatewayJ](https://redirect.github.com/GatewayJ) in [#​9614](https://redirect.github.com/rustfs/rustfs/pull/9614)
- fix(kms,sse): backport KMS and SSE fixes to 1.0.7 by [@​reatang](https://redirect.github.com/reatang) in [#​9613](https://redirect.github.com/rustfs/rustfs/pull/9613)
- fix(scanner): walk directories with an explicit stack by [@​cxymds](https://redirect.github.com/cxymds) in [#​9623](https://redirect.github.com/rustfs/rustfs/pull/9623)
- fix(replication): verify probe cleanup against target versions by [@​cxymds](https://redirect.github.com/cxymds) in [#​9624](https://redirect.github.com/rustfs/rustfs/pull/9624)
- fix(s3): restore 1.0.7 compatibility and batch delete correctness by [@​cxymds](https://redirect.github.com/cxymds) in [#​9622](https://redirect.github.com/rustfs/rustfs/pull/9622)
- fix(ecstore): backport bulk delete repair to 1.0.7 by [@​houseme](https://redirect.github.com/houseme) in [#​9633](https://redirect.github.com/rustfs/rustfs/pull/9633)
- fix(ecstore): gate rebalance test fixtures on test-util by [@​houseme](https://redirect.github.com/houseme) in [#​9634](https://redirect.github.com/rustfs/rustfs/pull/9634)

**Full Changelog**: <https://github.com/rustfs/rustfs/compare/1.0.6...1.0.7>
